title: Microreactor-assisted synthesis of surface-active oxygen-rich Mn–Ce oxide particles and their catalytic activity in the wet air oxidation process
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26778-26788
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01056C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tenta Yamaryo, Takumi Hatashita, Noritsugu Kometani
Liquid-phase oxidation using a central-collision type microreactor has been applied to the synthesis of Mn–Ce oxides with high density of surface oxygen species, exhibiting excellent catalytic performance for wet air oxidation of phenol.
